# The Art Sherpa

> A comprehensive platform for beginner painters offering free and premium acrylic and watercolor tutorials, community challenges, and artist certification programs.

The Art Sherpa provides structured painting education through video tutorials, seasonal art challenges like Acrylic April, and community engagement features. The platform serves both individual learners and aspiring paint party business owners through its Labs certification program.

## Key Topics

- Acrylic painting
- Watercolor tutorials
- Beginner art classes
- Acrylic April challenge
- Video tutorials
- Community events
- Zen doodling
- Paint party business
- Seasonal challenges
- Drawing templates
- Patron exclusive content
- Artist certification
- Step-by-step lessons
- Art community

## Learning & Tutorials

- [Videos](https://theartsherpa.com/videos): Video library for beginner painting tutorials in acrylic and watercolor
- [Beginner Acrylic Painting Course](https://theartsherpa.com/BeginnerAcrylicPaintingCourse): Free step-by-step beginner acrylic painting course with fundamentals
- [Traceables](https://theartsherpa.com/traceables): Downloadable drawing templates and seasonal traceable art resources

## Community & Events

- [Calendar](https://theartsherpa.com/calendar): Schedule of upcoming painting tutorials and seasonal art challenges
- [Acrylic April](https://theartsherpa.com/acrylicapril): Acrylic April community painting challenge with daily free lessons
- [Patron Exclusive Classes Image Gallery](https://theartsherpa.com/theartsherpacommunity/gallery/patron-exclusive-classes-image-gallery-join-here-https-theartsherpacom-patron/all): Exclusive member gallery showcasing patron-only art classes
- [Community Files & Resources](https://theartsherpa.com/theartsherpacommunity/file): Downloadable art templates, minibooks, and member resource files

## Account & Business Programs

- [Subscriptions & Login](https://theartsherpa.com/subscribe/subscriptions): User authentication and subscription management portal
- [Labs](https://theartsherpa.com/labs): Paint party business licensing and artist certification program hub

## Support
